ecology.zh: 棲地樣貌：接受保育補助的友善社區。生存威脅：對外來資源的過度依賴。牌義關聯：金幣六代表著「施予與獲得」——生態補償金的制度，在人類與石虎之間建立了一種良性的資源分配機制。
ecology.en:
Habitat: Wildlife-friendly communities supported by conservation incentives.
Risk: Over-reliance on external resources.
Note: The Six of Pentacles symbolizes "giving and receiving." In this context, ecological compensation schemes establish a virtuous cycle of resource distribution between humans and the leopard cat.
